main_text.l: latione dignemur : Ne sol aliquando exorbitet ab E-cliptica, directricem ei, & viæ istius peritissimam Intelli-gentiam adjunximus; Lapidi verò de simili comite non prospicimus, nihil veriti, ne forte dum labitur, à perpen-diculo deliret; hujus tamen error, errore solis non minus pernicios𝑢s, & exitiosus ef-set: non vitra fenestrarum, quid dico? non capita nostra tuta sunt, si lapides oblivi-scuntur viæ suæ, si sursum rue-re, aut huc illuc in transver-sum palari statuunt, Asenim, ars major in motu siderum, indu-stria plus: Eà re sideribus assi-stentes Intelligentiæ dantur: Bo-nam

page.notes: Marginal words at the far left belong to the facing page's outer edge and are only partly legible; not transcribed. Some letters are doubtful in the scan: "pernicios𝑢s" should read "perniciosus" (the word is printed "perniciosus"; the final letters are uncertain). The line "ars major" is the start of "Ars" with a broken initial; "Asenim" is read as printed. The catchword "nam" at the foot right is the catchword and is taken as such.
